batch: C03c nonlinear regime oracles and event remainder repair

defect.trigger: A regular adaptive step falls a few ulps short of a mandatory GP phase arrival. Model-floor fitting reserved a hard-minimum-sized tail, magnifying charge subtraction roundoff and causing trapezoidal current ringing.
defect.reproduction: Ngspice-dialect NPN saturation, 1 ns exact delay and 4 ps maximum step: the old accepted grid inserted a 4.011825970882184e-23 s interval at 2 ns.
defect.repair: Balance the remaining gap before reserving the integration floor, retaining the original mandatory clock and both step ceilings. Preserve real short intervals and floor-pinned event policies.

oracle.source_reference: ngspice-46 src/spicelib/devices/bjt/bjtload.c: base charge, excess phase and forward diffusion charge sections
oracle.method: Independent algebra under prescribed terminal voltages: both high-injection and Early-effect terms in I_BE/Q_B; instantaneous reverse transport; analytical forward-charge derivative; analytical delayed input for ExactDelay and a separate ngspice Weil recurrence on actual accepted intervals. No core device or history/interpolation evaluator is called by the oracle.
oracle.initialization: Operating point, smooth zero-initial-slope input and constant prehistory

limits.fine_base_A: 1e-14 + 0.02 * peak analytical base magnitude; includes first-order startup/event-restart samples at requested RELTOL=0.01
limits.refinement: Exact-delay saturation and high-injection collector/base maximum errors must each decrease below 0.7 times the coarse error. Reverse-active errors are already at roundoff.
